quest.title: Step by Step
quest.description: Doolan is frustrated and wandering around the Thousand Winds Temple...

dialogues.speaker: Patchi the Curious
dialogues.text: There's no such THING as a perfect plan when you're on an adventure! How are you going to make any progress at all if you keep deliberating like this?

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: If the plan isn't perfect, then we need to be prepared for anything!

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: Ah, you see, we are planning to go exploring in the <color=#00E1FFFF>Thousand Winds Temple</color>. But Ms. Patchi here doesn't have any adventuring experience...

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: The inside of the temple is swarming with monsters these days, not to mention the terrifying Ruin Guard at the entrance... We will only put our lives at risk if we rush into this.

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: I am only trying to ensure Ms. Patchi's safety— Well, okay... our collective safety.

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: I am trying to persuade her of the merits of devising a meticulous and foolproof plan for this adventure.

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: But I fear if we start with some basic reconnaissance near the temple grounds, Patchi will get too excited and go charging in...

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: I need to stay here and keep an eye on her. Could you go and survey the area for me?

response.speaker: Doolan
response.text: Wonderful! But be sure to observe everything carefully. A single detail overlooked could spell the failure of our adventure.

response.speaker: Doolan
response.text: Whatever happens out there, I need you to tell me everything about it.

choices.text: Why don't I keep an eye on Patchi for you instead?

response.speaker: Doolan
response.text: N—No, that won't work! I, uh— There are all sorts of details in the current plan I still need to go over with her...

response.speaker: Doolan
response.text: Help me go and look for clues. Please!

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: Please, everything depends on you! Your findings will make or break my whole adventure.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I found out a few things...

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: This is excellent news. Wonderful. Fantastic! Thank you, take these for your trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: Ms. Patchi! There has been a major change of plan...
